title: Bodycam: When A Fraudster Gets Exposed
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On September 1st, 2023. An officer was dispatched to a bank about a man who seemed to have a fake ID attempting to pull out a large amount of cash. When Police questioned the man, his story did not seem to add up. The man had a New York ID card but lived in Florida, he also said he lived in Orlando but drove to Stuart which is approximately 2 hours away to withdraw money?. The man then confessed saying this was not his idea, it was two black males who picked him up from the street, bought him clothes and told him he would receive compensation after successfully withdrawing the cash. This is footage of the events that followed.
